ValidationRule.description: Restrict the file types that can be uploaded to salesforce
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(!CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'tiff'),!CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'tif'),!CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'JPEG'),!CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'JPG'),!CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'gif'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'bmp'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'png'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'pdf'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'doc'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'docx'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'xls') ,!CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'xlsx'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'xlsb'),!CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'ppt'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'pptx'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'msg'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'eml'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'rtf'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'txt'),!CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'csv'), !CONTAINS( PathOnClient , 'zip'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This file has a file type which is not supported by CMOS. Please note it is not possible to load this file onto CMOS
